run_gpt2_perplexity_eval: run a GPT-2 perplexity evaluation on wikitext data using evaluate_gpt2.py with a saved model checkpoint
run_gpt2_lambada_cloze_eval: run a Lambada cloze evaluation on GPT-2 using evaluate_gpt2.py with optional strict mode for harder formulation
run_gpt2_webtext_ppl_eval: run a webtext perplexity evaluation on GPT-2 using pretrain_gpt2.py with configurable eval iterations
run_gpt2_multinode_eval: run a GPT-2 evaluation with model parallelism across multiple GPUs using torch distributed launch
run_gpt2_openai_checkpoint_eval: run a GPT-2 evaluation loading weights from saved OpenAI or HuggingFace checkpoints
